description.en: A one-plugin index for dsh-fast-mode. Add this URL as an index source in Plugins → Discover.
description.zh: dsh-fast-mode 的单插件索引。在「插件 → 发现 → 索引源」里添加这个地址即可。

description.en: Per-conversation fast mode for multi-step tasks: batches independent tool calls and drops redundant steps. Pooled over 7 blocks and 120 valid paired runs: about 20% less total wall-clock time (0.798x, median 0.829x); 25-39% on the shapes it fits (codeimpl 0.608x, stategraph 0.708x, migrate 0.748x); hidden tests still passing.
description.zh: 单会话开关的快速模式：合并可并行的工具调用、减少冗余步骤。7 块 120 对有效配对的合池结果：整任务总墙钟约快 20%（0.798×，逐格中位 0.829×）；适合的形状快 25–39%（codeimpl 0.608×、stategraph 0.708×、migrate 0.748×）；隐藏测试仍全绿。
